high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be an elevator. The individual is wearing a white t-shirt with the text "Black Sabbath World Tour 1973" printed on it, along with a graphic of the band members. They have dark, shoulder-length hair styled in loose waves and are wearing a black belt with circular metal buckles over blue jeans. A green bag is slung over their left shoulder. The person is holding a smartphone with a case that has a design featuring scissors and a heart. They are also wearing white earphones.
